description:
List the WhatsApp chats agents have had, newest first, optionally for one number, one agent, or open or closed ones.

Requires scope `whatsapp:read`.

ending_before.description: Cursor from a previous response. Fetches the page before it. Not with starting_after.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Fetches the page after it.

name: list_whatsapp_conversations
title: List WhatsApp conversations
